headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving outsized gains for a few firms.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest single‑digit increases to over 50% YoY. AI‑related revenue surged at several companies, boosting margins for the high‑growth peers. Profitability was uneven, with some firms posting strong profit jumps while others saw declines. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at a few peers.

themes.title: AI‑led growth
themes.detail: AI revenue rose sharply, delivering double‑digit profit lifts at HCLTech and contributing to large‑deal wins at Infosys and LTM.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins slipped or stayed flat for mid‑tier firms despite revenue gains, reflecting higher cost structures.

themes.title: Dividend focus
themes.detail: Most companies declared or increased interim dividends, signalling cash‑return emphasis.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue up 17.4% YoY and profit jumped 19.6% with AI‑driven deal pipeline.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue growth modest at 9.1% YoY and profit fell 1.9% YoY.

domain_outlook.note: No company mentioned media or broadcasting projects.
No explicit references to entertainment or streaming.
Gaming was not cited in any report.
